text:
Casey: Launch went smooth overall, but we have a real backlog of small regressions + a few customer feature asks piling up. Need to decide next 2-week focus: patch crash/latency bugs or prioritize a couple of UX enhancements for paying customers?
Marta: agree we should be surgical. what's the current crash/latency delta vs SLOs?
Devon: crash rate is up ~0.6% last 24h (from 0.1%). 95th latency spike for embeddings route +220ms on average. A/B of new batcher still running.
Sam: customers reporting "embedding instability" in support threads — ~5 escalations from top-tier in last 48h. also 2 requests for configurable cache TTLs (revenue impact small but recurring ask).
Ajay: sounds like two buckets: reliability (CRASH, LAT) and experience (ENH). My instinct: reliability first for next patch, but leave a fast path for one high-impact enhancement if it unlocks expansion for a big account.
Casey: +1. Propose: triage by impact and fix-time. If fix <= 2 dev-days and mitigates >1 top-customer complaint, include in patch. Larger UX enhancements go into a scoped mini-epic for next sprint. Thoughts?
Marta: sounds reasonable. Can we get quick estimates? I'll coordinate with eng on effort.
Devon: estimate for major crash root cause (KV cache desync) = 3-4 dev-days. There's a smaller guardrail we can ship in ~0.5 day that reduces incidence by ~60% (feature flag).
Sam: the cache TTL config is ~2 dev-days + docs. The UX enhancement (cache UI) is >8 days.
Casey: ok prioritize: 1) ship guardrail flag for cache desync (0.5d) 2) urgent latency mitigations from batcher (1-2d) 3) include cache TTL toggle if dev <=2d and no regression risk. Defer full UX console to next sprint.
Ajay: agree. For transparency, let's publish a short 1-paragraph customer-facing note and a changelog entry when guardrail and latency patch ship. I'll draft.
Marta: assigning owners: Devon -> guardrail + batcher tweaks; Sam -> evaluate TTL toggle risk and support messaging; Casey -> customer note + release PR.
Devon: starting a mini-branch now. pushing a short test matrix in thread:```
- unit tests around KV sync (new)
- e2e with small/large batcher workloads
- canary to 10% traffic for 1h
```
Sam: adding a support playbook snippet for affected customers. will include: recommended workaround, how to enable guardrail (flag), escalation contacts.
planning-bot: NOTE: Proposed patch window Wed 10:00-12:00 PST. Reply with :thumbsup: to approve or suggest alternate.
Casey: :thumbsup: Wed works. Marta please confirm devs can meet canary window.
Marta: agreed. Devon confirmed offline.
Ajay: draft customer note posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/postlaunch/1801234567-guardrail-note (will update before release).
Casey: final checklist before patch: 1) tests green 2) canary 10% for 1h 3) support playbook ready 4) changelog and customer note. If all green, ship and follow with 24h monitoring.
Devon: will post canary results here. starting work now.
Sam: prepping support messages and a short FAQ.
Casey: thanks team — nice compact plan. We'll reassess after canary results and decide what enhancements to pull into the mini-epic for the next sprint.
planning-bot: ACTION: owners assigned {"Devon":"guardrail+batcher","Sam":"TTL+support","Casey":"note+release-PR","Marta":"coordination"}. Deadline: 72h to initial canary.
